mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase and may potentiate cefepime's potential for disulfiram-like reactions; cephalosporins with methyltetrazole side chains can cause alcohol-like reactions, though cefepime has minimal this risk compared to other cephalosporins.
action: Monitor for disulfiram-like reaction symptoms (flushing, nausea, chest pain); counsel patient on strict alcohol avoidance; use only if benefits outweigh risks.
